items.title: Tony Marino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 25, 2025
items.q: it was really fun on that bus ride to the venue to be with Clark Terry and hear his stories

ctx.x: Rubbing elbows with those gentlemen from the earlier era is so enriching.

Yeah. Oh it is. You get on a bus and some of these greats come and they start talking stories and I mean it’s just – you realize they’re human and it’s so great to, you know, experience what they experienced you know. But you know when you think about the older black musicians with the racial thing they had to go through, I don’t have a clue. What that was, I’ll never know what that is. You know but they never – I mean my experience is I didn’t feel ever that racial thing with them. They always made me feel…
I was able to have some of that spirit next to me in this project I do, so I know what you’re talking about.
